name: Cubing in the Valley 2023

venue.name: Thousand Oaks Community Center
venue.address: 2525 N Moorpark Rd, Thousand Oaks, CA 91360

information:
## Each competitor is limited to 1 guest ONLY. This is a strict requirement. If you list more than 1 guest, your registration may not be accepted. 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingintheValley2023#24988-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
